Designed With Xbox

 When it came time to create our first-ever limited edition Meta Quest, we knew it had to be iconic—and the results speak for themselves.

 

 We worked in close partnership with Xbox to create a limited edition Quest that reflects the unmistakable Xbox colors. We love the clean look of our standard Quest 3S, but Meta Quest 3S Xbox Edition is undeniably sleek in Xbox’s signature Carbon Black, while the Velocity Green accents lend the headset a subtle pop of color that’s unlike anything we’ve done before.

 We’re also including a carbon black Elite Strap in the box for increased comfort during your play sessions, plus matching Touch Plus controllers so you’ll have a fully color-coordinated setup for all your gaming needs.

 

 And for the first time ever, we’re including an Xbox controller with Quest as well (and in a limited edition colorway). While you can pair any Xbox Wireless Controller, Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2, or Xbox Adaptive Controller to Quest using Bluetooth, this one comes pre-paired with the headset and shares the same look as the other accessories, with a Carbon Black chassis and Velocity Green highlights on the face buttons and analog sticks.

 Your Favorite Xbox Games Are Bigger Than Ever

 With the included Xbox controller, you’ll have all the hardware you need to unbox Meta Quest 3S Xbox Edition and immediately start playing your favorite Xbox games via the Xbox app on a massive 26-foot virtual display.

 

 The Xbox app lets Xbox Game Pass Ultimate members play hundreds of the biggest Xbox games, including day-one first-party releases, plus a selection of third-party hits that’s constantly refreshed.

 Games are streamed directly to your headset (meaning no waiting on a download), and you can choose from four different display sizes—including a massive theater-size screen (up to 26 feet) for full immersion. Play in an Xbox-themed immersive space for minimal distractions, or place the virtual screen right in your room.

 Using the Xbox app on Meta Quest 3S is great at home and also great for on-the-go gaming. No need to travel with your console. Throw Quest 3S in a backpack, and it’s like you’ve packed an entire home theater setup. All you need is the headset, controller, and a WiFi connection (20 Mbps or higher recommended), and you’ll be able to pick up from where you left off and enjoy your favorite Xbox games in a hotel, at your parents’ house, or wherever else life might take you. You can even play multiplayer cross-platform with people on an Xbox console.

 

 Xbox Cloud Gaming (Beta) requires an Xbox Game Pass Ultimate membership, so to get you started, Meta Quest 3S Xbox Edition includes three months of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate in the box—and don’t worry, if you’re already an Xbox Game Pass Ultimate member, those three months will stack on top of your existing time.*

 The Magic of Quest

 As part of our Quest 3 family, Quest 3S features Qualcomm’s powerful Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 chip. Expect bleeding-edge performance, lightning-fast load times, and beautiful visuals that push what’s possible for a standalone headset. Meta Quest 3S also features full-color Passthrough, enabling you to seamlessly blend your physical surroundings with the virtual world and unlock a whole new type of content—including the ability to play your Xbox games on a larger-than-life screen, right in your living room. This bundle gives more people an opportunity to get their hands on this innovative device and enjoy the immersive experiences that we have to offer across the Meta Horizon Platform.
